tests.text: The game starts normally.
The hero displays its combat power.
Every enemy displays its combat power.
Clicking a valid enemy selects it.
Clicking an invalid enemy shows a warning.

The hero moves automatically toward
a valid selected enemy.
The hero stops within attack range.
A successful attack plays an animation.
Defeating an enemy increases player power.
Defeated enemies are removed correctly.
Clicking a weapon starts automatic movement.
Weapon pickup increases player power.
Collected weapons cannot be collected again.
Clicking empty ground moves the hero.

The hero does not automatically attack
without target selection.

Player power 10 defeats enemy power 3.

Expected result:
13.

Player power 10 cannot defeat
enemy power 10.

Player power 10 cannot defeat
enemy power 15.

Player power 13 collecting +20
becomes power 33.
Enemy power is absorbed at 100%.
Power values remain integers.
Invalid interactions do not change power.
Combat calculations are deterministic.

Power labels update immediately
after a completed interaction.

Enemy label colors update after
player power changes.
The hero moves around obstacles.
The hero does not pass through walls.
The hero reaches valid interaction positions.
Changing targets updates navigation.
Unreachable targets produce a warning.
The hero does not teleport.
The attack animation faces the target.
Combat resolves only within attack range.
Combat validation uses strict inequality.
Enemy defeat animation plays correctly.
Boss defeat triggers victory.

Invalid Boss selection does not
incorrectly trigger victory or defeat.
Level 1 can be completed.
Level 2 can be completed.
Level 3 can be completed.
Level 1 uses the required enemy power values.
Level 2 uses the required enemy power values.
Level 3 uses the required enemy power values.
Weapon bonuses match configuration.
Level 1 Boss power equals 150.
Level 2 Boss power equals 500.
Level 3 Boss power equals 1500.
Every level has at least one valid solution.
Completing a level unlocks the next level.
Completed levels remain replayable.
Restarting restores original level power values.
Unlocked levels persist after refresh.
Completed levels persist after refresh.
Audio settings persist after refresh.
Restarting does not remove unlocked progress.
Main menu works.
Level selection works.
Pause and resume work.
Victory screen works.
Deadlock screen works when appropriate.
Settings screen works.
All user-facing text is in Chinese.
Portrait layout works.
Landscape layout works.
Mobile tapping selects correct targets.
Desktop clicking selects correct targets.
Orientation changes preserve game state.

The game does not require
runtime third-party APIs.
Movement remains smooth on mobile.
tests.manual_instructions: On a named physical mainstream mobile device, play every level in portrait and landscape; record device/browser versions, frame-time capture and observed defects. Screenshots or desktop emulation do not establish real-device smoothness.

tests.text: Power labels remain readable.

Repeated target changes do not
cause navigation errors.

Repeated restarts do not create
duplicate update loops.
Scene resources are cleaned up correctly.
Combat power is displayed above characters.
Only weaker enemies can be defeated.

Defeated enemy power is added
to the player's power.
Weapons increase player power.
The hero moves after target selection.

Combat is resolved automatically
after approaching the target.
The game uses an open-field layout.
The game does not use fixed tower floors.
The final Boss requires sufficient power.

The game retains numerical
power-growth puzzle gameplay.
